plan.rationale: The existing sawmill is incoherent with Valoria's medieval aesthetic. It lacks architectural hierarchy, spatial logic, and material consistency with the Bastion. This new design addresses three core defects: 1) It replaces the flat platform with a coherent masonry foundation that visually integrates with the Bastion. 2) It establishes a clear spatial composition with a front-facing saw bay and rear workshop, creating a functional and visually balanced structure. 3) It uses the correct material palette: dressed limestone piers, oak frame, and blue slate roof matching the Bastion's palette. The design is proportionally scaled (X/Y footprint 8.5m x 6.5m, Z height 6.5m) and oriented with the front facing Y negative, as required. The lean-to roof and log-yard orientation are optional but enhance the workshop's functionality and visual interest.
